entries.title: Tell us how you found SimchaKit after you create your first event
entries.body: After you create your first event you can optionally say how you heard about SimchaKit. It takes one tap, you can skip it, and it helps us reach more families like yours.

entries.title: Keep your calendar subscription private with harder-to-guess links
entries.body: When you regenerate your calendar subscription link in Admin Mode, the new link is now much harder to guess, so only the people you share it with can follow your event.

entries.title: Choose which hotel blocks guests can see; the Accommodations tab shows which are shared
Add a guest address, dress code, map link and parking note to each timeline event, and a welcome note to Event Details
Give guests one page for the schedule, directions and where to stay
entries.body: After a guest replies, their RSVP page now has an Event details tab with each sub-event they are invited to, with the venue, address, dress code, parking, a Get directions link and Add to calendar. Hotels you choose to share appear under Where to stay. Change anything in Admin Mode and it shows the next time they open or refresh the page.
